outputs.explanation: Panel a is a schematic/example illustration of image cropping/rotation/resizing, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel b shows example micrographs illustrating image spacing, not a quantitative plot.
Panel c shows example micrographs illustrating insets/magnification, not a quantitative plot.
Panel d shows example micrographs illustrating brightness/contrast adjustment, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel e shows example micrographs/staining illustrating channel annotation, not a quantitative plot.
Panel f shows example micrographs illustrating grayscale channel display, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel g shows example micrographs with calibration scales, not a plot of averaged data requiring individual points.
